"1. Open the APP and click the + button
2. Select (Device AP Network Configuration)
3. Select the corresponding model, such as Small Camera
4. Confirm that the red light of the device flashes slowly or the reset is successful. After the device prompts Waiting for network configuration 5. After confirmation, check the Confirmed red light flashes and click Next
6. Click the Go to WiFi Configuration button
7. The mobile phone system wifi connection starts with DGO or AYS Hotspot
8. Return to the APP and the list will be refreshed to AP Mode
9. Click OK on the pop-up window of whether to configure the network and jump to the Wi Fi Settings interface 10. Select from the device list Connect wifi to the device and enter the correct password 11. Click Next
12 The device enters networking mode, and the APP returns to the Device List interface and prompts Network connection successful"

"1.ID is the unique identification number of the camera. Each camera only corresponds to one ID
2.DGO appears in the wifi device AP mode. The beginning of DGO is the device number (such as DGO-124556-DFGJK)
3.4G The device can be viewed on the label on the device body. If it is torn, please turn the device on and run it for a while, then shut it down. "Make sure the device has been started normally and is in hotspot mode (the red light flashes slowly)
2. For devices with external antennas, please confirm that the antennas are connected
3. The Android phone system will pop up a security prompt during the connection process. Please confirm to authorize the system to connect to the hotspot.
4. In the Apple mobile phone system, please make sure that the APP has turned on the (Local Network) and [Precise Location] permissions. 5. Make sure that the phone system (Positioning) and [Positioning Permissions] are turned on
6. Please try to restart the device or Change the mobile phone connection
7. Make sure the device has sufficient power
8. If the problem cannot be solved after trying the above methods, please contact the merchant for after-sales treatment
Note: The AP hotspot cannot connect to the Internet without a signal from the camera. , so it is normal for the system to prompt Network Unavailable when connecting to the hotspot."

"1.2. The difference between 4G WiFi and 5G WiFi
(1) 2.4G is a wireless technology. Since its frequency band is between 2.400GHz~2.4835GHz, it is referred to as 2.4G wireless technology
(2) 5GWiFi is It refers to the wireless technology developed based on the IEEE 802.11ac standard. Because the IEEE802.11ac technology itself works in the 5GHz frequency band, it is also called 5GWiFi
2. The difference between 5GWiFi and 5G communication networks. 5G in 5GWiFi refers to the frequency band of wireless signals: The G in 4G and 5G in mobile networks refers to the English word Generation, 4G refers to the fourth generation mobile phone mobile communication standard, and 5G refers to the fifth generation mobile phone mobile communication standard.
3. Why can’t the device connect to 5G WiFiV
The WiFi module used by the 380 product only supports connection to 2.4G WiFi and cannot identify or connect to 5G WiFi, so it cannot use 5G WiFi or mixed-band WiFi"
